column1: # comment: "Model-serving alignments (extensions/model-serving slice). FLAGSHIP 1 \u2014 OpenTelemetry-GenAI (the occurrent shadow, INHABITED-ALIGNMENT.md): the OTel GenAI semantic conventions (the experimental gen_ai.* namespace) describe spans for model calls, tool calls, and agent operations \u2014 the runtime/invocation layer FAITHFULLY, and NOTHING of the durable subject, the tenure, continuity, or claims-as-observations. WHAT THIS FILE ACTUALLY EMITS: SSSOM gmeow:TermEquivalence term\u2194term rows at concept grain (below), pointing at the dereferenceable OTel-GenAI semconv registry concepts. That is the projected grain the SSSOM path emits, and it is the honest grain for these targets: the OTel gen_ai.* targets are span attribute KEYS with no RDF vocabulary, so a lawful logic:Correspondence lens \u2014 which operates over RDF path semantics \u2014 has no RDF view to project into, and the term row pointing at the semconv registry concept is the well-posed alignment. The richer correspondences the asymmetry would call for are recorded HERE AS PROJECTION DOCTRINE / intended shape, NOT as generated artifacts: (1) SSSOM term\u2194term for the 1:1 cases (below) \u2014 the layer this file ships; (2) EDOAL structural correspondences where no single term matches \u2014 'gmeow:AgentSession \u2261 an OTel trace whose spans carry gen_ai.*' is a class-expression correspondence, not a term row; (3) FnO value transforms \u2014 gmeow:duringInterval \u2192 span start/end (epoch-nanos), gmeow:samplingTemperature \u2192 gen_ai.request.temperature; (4) CONSTRUCT that would materialize the target view AND the inverse ingest lift. Layers 2\u20134 describe the alignment's intended shape as design characterization; only layer 1 is materialized. DIRECTIONALITY (the Galois-connection shape): projection GMEOW \u2192 OTel is a SoundUnderApproximation \u2014 every emitted span is faithful, but the endurant/epistemic structure (the DigitalSubject and its tenure, InhabitationTenure/Configuration, IdentityContinuityAssessment, ControlAssessment, InhabitationClaim/standpoints, TransferManifest and migration boundaries) is DROPPED, and the ledger says so; ingest OTel \u2192 GMEOW is ENRICHING (subsume-and-extend) \u2014 a trace lifts to a gmeow:RuntimeExecution with its gmeow:ModelInvocation / gmeow:ToolCall sub-events, and GMEOW ADDS the subject, tenure, and attributed provenance the trace could not express, the super-ontology earning its name. ML-METADATA (the LLM-ops hub): gmeow:ModelArtifact / gmeow:ModelDeployment / gmeow:RuntimeExecution align to ML-Schema (mls:Model / mls:Implementation / mls:Run). BECAUSE ML-Schema is a real RDF/OWL vocabulary \u2014 a lawful logic:Correspondence lens HAS an RDF view to project into (unlike the OTel span-attribute-key targets) \u2014 this seam materializes MORE than the SSSOM term rows below: the sibling mappings/ml-schema.ttl authors EDOAL structural correspondences AND the forward SPARQL-CONSTRUCT target view (layers 1, 2, and forward-4) for the three classes plus the one well-posed property leg gmeow:executionOfDeployment \u2291 mls:executes (Run\u2192Implementation). WHAT IS NOT PROJECTED, AND WHY (Principle 7, per target): (a) FnO value transforms \u2014 NOT well-posed for this seam: model-serving owns only owl:ObjectProperty terms, and the literal-valued candidates the doctrine named (sampling temperature, gmeow:duringInterval \u2192 epoch-nanos) are owned by the ai / agentic / temporal slices and are not re-authored here (scope discipline) \u2014 an honest terminal state, not a gap-to-fill; (b) gmeow:deploymentArtifact (Deployment\u2192Artifact) and the composed Execution\u2192\u2026\u2192Artifact relator path (an edoalPath candidate) have NO lawful mls: counterpart \u2014 in ML-Schema a Model is the OUTPUT of a Run (mls:hasOutput), not an Implementation-bound artifact, so serving-binding \u2260 production-output and projecting either would overclaim; (c) gmeow:valueClassMap (\u2192 edoal:AttributeValueRestriction) is inapplicable: no model-serving value discriminates into distinct mls: subclasses; (d) the inverse ingest (put) lift \u2014 bare mls: triples \u2192 gmeow: model-serving terms \u2014 IS NOW MATERIALIZED as a validation-only mint-with-claim ingest CONSTRUCT (mappings/ml-schema.put.rq). It emits only what bare mls: triples warrant: the class/predicate lift (mls:Model / mls:Implementation / mls:Run \u2192 gmeow:ModelArtifact / gmeow:ModelDeployment / gmeow:RuntimeExecution, and mls:executes \u2192 gmeow:executionOfDeployment) as a reasoner-INERT gmeow:StatementMetadata reified claim per lifted atom (the qSubject/qPredicate/qObject triad), each gmeow:mappedFrom its mls: source term on its annotation list and gmeow:wasGeneratedBy the ONE deterministic gmeow:ImportActivity \u2014 the interior triple is NEVER asserted, so no reasoner treats the lift as extracted fact; it is carried as an import-derived candidate preimage. The durable subject / gmeow:DigitalSubjectTenure the source cannot express is NOT synthesized; it remains disclosed residue on each binding's gmeow:ingestClaim, and the put carries an honest PutGet/ObligationUnknown claim, never a lossless recovery; (e) Model Cards (no standard external RDF vocabulary \u2014 a JSON/protobuf toolkit; gmeow:ModelCard is internal), Croissant (JSON-LD but dataset-centred \u2014 cr:Dataset / RecordSet / Field, not the model / deployment / execution terms this slice owns), SPDX-AI (a packaging / BOM concern owned by the artifact-distribution alignment \u2014 gmeow:ModelArtifact is aligned to gmeow:Distribution by reference), and MLflow (no formal RDF ontology) each stay SSSOM-grain-by-design. Every mls: correspondence is a lossy SubsumedBy at closeMatch / relatedMatch grain (LossyLens rung), never an equivalence; the put leg is materialized as a validation-only mint-with-claim (ml-schema.put.rq) whose lifts are reasoner-inert gmeow:StatementMetadata reified claims wasGeneratedBy one deterministic import activity, and the subject / tenure the source cannot express is disclosed as residue, never fabricated (under-approximation, L/I). LOSS LEDGER: the OTel and ML rows are skos:relatedMatch or closeMatch (cross-category or broader-target, lossy); the flagship projection is honestly a SoundUnderApproximation, not 'supported' \u2014 what a target cannot hold is recorded, never silently dropped (Principles 4, 7)."

# # INHERITED BY REFERENCE (not re-authored here): PROV-O — gmeow:RuntimeExecution / gmeow:AgentSession ⊑ gmeow:Activity ↔ prov:Activity (owned by the provenance slice); gmeow:ModelArtifact ⊑ gmeow:InformationObject ↔ the kernel entity alignment. THIS FILE emits SSSOM term rows only; the ML-Schema EDOAL structural + forward-CONSTRUCT correspondences AND the inverse ingest (put) lift ARE materialized off the sibling mappings/ml-schema.ttl (ML-Schema is a real RDF vocabulary with an RDF view to project into): the forward target view and a validation-only mint-with-claim ingest CONSTRUCT (ml-schema.put.rq) that lifts only the bare class/predicate structure, attributes each lifted node gmeow:wasGeneratedBy a gmeow:ImportActivity and gmeow:mappedFrom its mls: source term, and discloses the durable subject / tenure as residue rather than synthesizing it. The OTel gen_ai.* EDOAL/FnO structural-and-value correspondences remain projection doctrine, not materialized artifacts — the term row at concept grain is the well-posed projection for the OTel span-attribute-key targets (no RDF view exists for a lawful logic:Correspondence lens to project into).

# # OWNED ELSEWHERE (align once): the OTel gen_ai.* rows for gmeow:ModelInvocation (an LLM chat span), gmeow:ToolCall (a tool span), gmeow:usedTool (gen_ai.tool.name), and gmeow:samplingTemperature / samplingMaxTokens (gen_ai.request.*) belong to the ai and agentic slices that mint those terms — referenced from model-serving transitively, never re-aligned here.

column6: the session aggregate ↔ an OTel trace whose spans carry gen_ai.* (gen_ai.conversation.id); a structural (EDOAL) correspondence surfaced as a loose term row — the endurant subject/tenure the session carries has no OTel counterpart

the content-digested served model ↔ mls:Model, ML-Schema's trained-model artifact; a close but not exact match — mls:Model is the learned model, gmeow:ModelArtifact adds the distribution/versioning framing aligned by reference to the software slice
the served model artifact's identity ↔ gen_ai.request.model / gen_ai.response.model; OTel carries the model name as a span attribute, dropping the content-digested artifact identity

the served, callable realization ↔ mls:Implementation, ML-Schema's executable implementation of an algorithm; relatedMatch only — a gmeow:ModelDeployment additionally binds a service identity, host, endpoint, and serving interval

the served, callable realization's provider/service ↔ gen_ai.system (e.g. anthropic); OTel records the serving provider as a flat attribute, dropping the deployment's artifact·host·endpoint·interval binding structure

a particular running of a deployment ↔ mls:Run, ML-Schema's execution of an implementation on data; relatedMatch — mls:Run is training/evaluation-centred, gmeow:RuntimeExecution is a serving occurrent within which gmeow:ModelInvocation events occur

the occurrent running of a deployment ↔ an OTel agent root span (gen_ai.agent.id / .name, gen_ai.operation.name = create_agent/invoke_agent); the span captures the process, not the deployment relator it runs
